text:
Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, I have free time on Monday 10:00-10:30, and also Monday 14:00-14:30. Would one of those suit you? If neither works, tell me a time that does and I'll fit it in around my commitments.

Best,
Sarah

Dear Sarah,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me. I've put our 1:1 on my calendar for that slot, so it's booked — please put it on yours as well.

See you then.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Thank you — Monday 10:00-10:30 is now on my calendar too, so our 1:1 is booked. I've logged the change.

See you next week.

Best,
Sarah
